Provides up-to-date documentation and code examples for any library or framework. Use the resolve-library-id tool first to get a library ID, then use get-library-docs to fetch current docs — bypassing LLM training cutoffs entirely.
Tools: • resolve-library-id — resolve a package name to a Context7 library ID • get-library-docs — fetch current docs for a library ID

Runs Claude Code in one-shot mode as a sub-agent. Exposes a single `claude_code` tool that accepts a natural-language prompt and executes it with full Claude Code capabilities (file edits, bash, git, search, etc.) using --dangerously-skip-permissions.
Repo layout inside the container: /workspace/ordomatics — Ordomatics project root (docker-compose, scripts, .git) /workspace/odoo-llm — odoo-llm module repo (.git, all modules) /workspace/whatsapp — whatsapp module repo (.git, all modules) /mnt/odoo-llm — same as /workspace/odoo-llm (Odoo addons path) /mnt/whatsapp — same as /workspace/whatsapp (Odoo addons path)
Always pass the relevant working directory in your prompt, e.g. "Your work folder is /workspace/odoo-llm\n\n..."
